paragraphs.en: It's Saturday morning. Today is Dad's birthday. He is at work now. Timur and his sister Sevara want to make a cake for him.
paragraphs.uz: Shanba kuni ertalab. Bugun dadasining tug'ilgan kuni. U hozir ishda. Temur va singlisi Sevara unga tort qilishmoqchi.

paragraphs.en: "Can you cook?" asks Sevara. "No, I can't," says Timur. "But Grandma can. Let's call her!" Grandma lives next door. She comes in five minutes.
paragraphs.uz: "Sen ovqat pishira olasanmi?" deb so'raydi Sevara. "Yo'q, olmayman," deydi Temur. "Lekin buvim oladi. Keling, unga qo'ng'iroq qilamiz!" Buvi qo'shni uyda yashaydi. U besh daqiqada keladi.

paragraphs.en: "We need some flour, some sugar, four eggs and some butter," says Grandma. Timur is putting the eggs in a bowl. Sevara is mixing the flour and sugar. The kitchen is very messy!
paragraphs.uz: "Bizga biroz un, biroz shakar, to'rtta tuxum va biroz sariyog' kerak," deydi buvi. Temur tuxumlarni idishga solyapti. Sevara un va shakarni aralashtiryapti. Oshxona juda tartibsiz!

paragraphs.en: The cake is in the oven for forty minutes. Then they put chocolate on top and write "Happy Birthday, Dad!" It looks beautiful.
paragraphs.uz: Tort qirq daqiqa pechda turadi. Keyin ular ustiga shokolad surtib, "Tug'ilgan kuningiz bilan, dada!" deb yozishadi. Juda chiroyli ko'rinadi.

paragraphs.en: At six o'clock, Dad comes home. "Surprise!" shout the children. Dad is very happy. "This is the best cake in the world!" he says. Grandma smiles.
paragraphs.uz: Soat oltida dadasi uyga keladi. "Syurpriz!" deb baqirishadi bolalar. Dadasi juda xursand. "Bu dunyodagi eng zo'r tort!" deydi u. Buvi jilmayadi.

questions.q: Where is Dad in the morning?
How many eggs do they need?
What time does Dad come home?
